messages:
maria: FinTrust sent their security questionnaire. they want per-tenant RBAC change history, log redaction proof, and KMS rotation evidence.
jonathan: do we have a per-tenant RBAC export today?
lee: not as a ready artifact. we store audit events in the audit topic; customer exports are aggregated. per-tenant export doable but must sanitize PII and secrets.
ravi: for SIEM we can stream full events to customer-managed endpoints, but for audits produce a filtered signed bundle.
maria: specific asks: 1) chronological RBAC role changes (who/when/before/after/reason), 2) attestation that no plaintext keys were stored, 3) rotation timestamps + KID snapshots.
jonathan: i'll draft a minimal export schema: timestamp, actor, role_before, role_after, justification, request_id, export_hmac. add per-export HMAC and signed manifest.
lee: KMS note: we use envelope encryption. DEKs wrapped by customer KEK or our KEK. we can include rotation timestamps and KIDs but never key material.
sam: vuln triage: rotation-agent had an edge case causing stale wrapped-key refs on failed rotations. mitigation deployed last week (hotfix + monitoring). include CVE tracker entry.
ravi: legal usually wants explicit language. sec-bot: Automated attestation templates: https://internal.redwood/sec/attestations.
maria: reference that template in bundle. on redaction: what do we keep vs redact?
lee: redact full user IDs, keep last 4 chars. hash rest with per-export ephemeral HMAC key; include verification info in manifest so they can validate within the bundle only.
jonathan: agreed. per-export HMAC prevents cross-bundle correlation. sign the whole manifest with our KMS.
sam: incident response snippet to include: detect (policy alert) -> triage -> freeze principals/rollback -> evidence capture -> postmortem. add SLA windows.
ravi: for evidence capture package: S3 snapshot of audit stream segment + checksums + signed oncall statement. we can automate via sec-packager. example: `sec-packager --tenant fintrust --from 2024-02-01 --to 2024-02-28 --sign`.
maria: who can produce a draft sanitized bundle by EOD Wednesday? also schedule a security review call Tue 10am PT.
lee: i'll implement the sanitizer and KMS rotation slice. est 2 days to produce bundle + signed manifest.
jonathan: i'll finalize schema and docs.
sam: i'll author incident runbook snippet and attach the CVE/PR links.
ravi: i'll wire up the sec-packager job path and the Splunk filtered-stream option.
sec-bot: Reminder: file follow-up in sec-requests tag `fintrust-audit`: https://internal.redwood/ops/sec-requests/new
oncall: Archive tier available for 3y retention but cost center approval required. include estimate in ticket.
maria: owners assigned lee/jonathan/sam/ravi. i'll coordinate the call and include retention ask in the ticket. proceed assuming Redwood-managed KEK unless FinTrust confirms BYO-KMS by Tue AM.
jonathan: note: BYO vs managed changes included artifacts (we can only provide KID+timestamps for BYO).
lee: i'll add unit tests to ensure no key material leaves exports.
sam: i'll include mitigation status: P3, hotfix deployed, monitoring added.
ravi: manifest fields to include: export_id, generated_by, window, kms_mode, hmac_algo, signed_digest, retention_note.
maria: good. closing unless blockers. :thumbsup:
